# InnaTri — Inna Ryzhykh, online running & triathlon coach

> Personal coaching for marathon, Ironman and 70.3 through TrainingPeaks. Data-driven training adapted to your work, travel, family and real-life schedule. 20+ years in sport, 60 athletes coached. The site is in three languages: Russian (/), Ukrainian (/ua/) and English (/en/).

Coach: Inna Ryzhykh (Инна Рыжих / Інна Рижих). Contact: Telegram https://t.me/InnaRH, email innaryzhykh@gmail.com, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/inna.tri, YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@innatri

## Coaching (English)

- [Online running & triathlon coach](https://innatri.com/en/): Personal coaching for marathon, Ironman and 70.3 through TrainingPeaks. Data-driven training adapted to your work, travel, family and real-life schedule.
- [Online running coach](https://innatri.com/en/run.html): Online running coach for the marathon, half marathon, 10K and 5K. A personal plan in TrainingPeaks, heart rate and pace analysis. 20+ years in sport. From $150 a month.
- [Online triathlon coach](https://innatri.com/en/triathlon.html): Personal online coaching for Ironman and 70.3. 20+ years in sport, 60 athletes coached. A plan in TrainingPeaks, session reviews and direct contact with your coach.
- [Pricing](https://innatri.com/en/pricing.html): Online coaching pricing: training plans, coach support, TrainingPeaks.
- [Reviews](https://innatri.com/en/reviews.html): Client reviews on training, progress, and coach support for triathlon and running.
- [Contact](https://innatri.com/en/contact.html): Get in touch with your coach: let's discuss your goals, training format, and start online coaching.

## Free tools (English)

- [VDOT calculator](https://innatri.com/en/calculator.html): Free VDOT calculator based on Jack Daniels' formula: training paces, 5 zones, race predictions from 5K to marathon, split tables and race nutrition plan.
- [Garmin running dashboard guide](https://innatri.com/en/guides/dashboard/): Turn your Garmin Connect Personal API Key into a free running dashboard with Claude Code: easy vs hard runs, load periodization, technique and fitness trends. Your data stays on your computer.

## Тренировки (русский)

- [Онлайн-тренер по бегу и триатлону](https://innatri.com/): Персональная подготовка к марафону, Ironman и 70.3 в TrainingPeaks. Тренер с опытом профессионального спорта и 8+ годами коучинга. План под работу, семью и реальный график.
- [Тренер по бегу онлайн](https://innatri.com/run.html): Тренер по бегу онлайн: индивидуальная подготовка к марафону, полумарафону, 10 и 5 км. План в TrainingPeaks, анализ пульса и темпа. 20+ лет в спорте. От 150 $ в месяц.
- [Тренер по триатлону онлайн](https://innatri.com/triathlon.html): Индивидуальная подготовка к Ironman и 70.3 онлайн. 20+ лет в спорте, 60 подготовленных атлетов. План в TrainingPeaks, разбор тренировок и связь с тренером.
- [Тарифы](https://innatri.com/pricing.html): Стоимость онлайн подготовки: планы тренировок, поддержка тренера, TrainingPeaks.
- [Отзывы](https://innatri.com/reviews.html)
- [Контакты](https://innatri.com/contact.html)
- [Калькулятор VDOT](https://innatri.com/calculator.html): Калькулятор VDOT онлайн по формуле Джека Дэниелса: темпы тренировок, 5 пульсовых зон, прогнозы от 5К до марафона, таблица сплитов и план питания на гонку.
- [Беговой дашборд по ключу Garmin](https://innatri.com/guides/dashboard/)
- [Гайд «Возвращение после перерыва»](https://innatri.com/guides/vozvrashchenie.html): Гайд о возвращении к бегу после отпуска, болезни, травмы или выгорания. 46 страниц в мобильном формате: схемы, критерии, красные флаги. Бесплатно.
